## Closed as not planned · 2026-11-15T16:06Z

Closed in the full p3 review the maintainer asked for on the triage thread on 2026-11-15 (「剩下的p3你都按照这个标准完整的审核一遍吧」). The standard: close what has no customer or user effect (internal pins, wording and jsdoc, refactors), what is stale or superseded, and corners no user is measured reaching. Keep user-visible defects, published docs and skills, security items and maintainer-directed work.

**This card:** Register SSO/SAML actions are visible only to platform administrators, an operator audience.

Reopen it if a user or a later change makes it matter.
